name: Oracle Park
note: Placed at its survey's origin (venues.ts SURVEY: way/24352572 in metres, x east z north; matched to OSM within 0.4 m, 2026-10-02) and built on the survey itself. Claimed by OSM id it was fitted to the one baked part (way/499568642) and came out a quarter size in the Cove. The Giants' ballpark (HOK, 2000), open to the sky: the city drew it as a 30 m solid extrusion because relation/7325085 (named, leisure=stadium, height=45) carries no building tag and relation/7330762 (building=stadium) is unnamed, so it reached neither the register nor any manifest. The builder derives its own frame from the footprint's longest edge — the 124 m right-field wall on McCovey Cove — so no `front` is given: the relation is unnamed, so "street" would find no frontage anyway and the loader falls back to the footprint's long axis, which the builder does not depend on. BUGS.md #156: the 4995686xx building:parts were NOT claimed here, so they drew ON TOP of this builder - w499568642 alone is 60 m over 33,567 m2, which is the 'huge generic building' the owner saw covering the park (2026-09-23). 646/647/648/649 are the floodlight masts that also reached a Haiku batch (#127). All nine now claimed so supersession removes them.

name: Chase Center
note: The Warriors' arena (Manica, 2019). Tagged building=yes, but it falls outside the bake's DETAIL box, so it is in pkg.fringe as coarse massing and the loader can find no ring for it — hence a lat/lon/size entry; the OSM way is named only so the fringe lump is removed. front=180 puts the model's +x east, so the two office blocks and the garage stand on the Third Street (west) side and the entrance canopy faces north to Warriors Way.
